description:
998000Pa Vacuum Cleaner Cordless Wireless Ultra Quiet Strong Suction Portable Home Car
Welcome to store

Our store will provide very favorable prices

Best quality and 100% authentic guaranteed.

Fast delivery from stock (1-3 business days)

Attentive customer service, we offer a 12-month warranty on all orders from the date of order

Follow the store to receive coupons!

Features:

8-in-1 Philips Cordless Mini Handheld Vacuum Cleaner

4 inches, not only can be used as a vacuum cleaner for home and car interior cleaning, but also can be used as a fan and vacuum compressor.

Powerful vacuum cleaner

The cordless handheld vacuum cleaner uses a high-performance motor with a rotation speed of up to 30,000 rpm, which can absorb pet hair, dust, dirt and paper debris, making it suitable for daily cleaning. Great for car and home cleaning.

Versatile and efficient

This portable vacuum cleaner works smoothly on almost any surface. It can clean your car interior, sofa, carpets, furniture and even your keyboard! To provide more convenience for your cleaning work, use useful accessories for different scenarios.

Cordless Car Vacuum Cleaner

Cleaning even hard-to-reach places is easy because the barrier cable no longer ties you down. This handheld vacuum cleaner gives users freedom of movement and no need for cords to clean houses, cars or tight corners.

Clean thoroughly

4 cleaning accessories, no dead spots. The handheld vacuum cleaner comes with 4 accessories. Caulking tool for narrow joints, corners. Brush nozzle for carpet and hair. Vacuum cleaner accessories and blower accessories meet your every need.

Package contents:

1 * long flat head

1 * short brush head

1* nozzle

1* User manual

1*USB charging cable
